learned_rules: Do not enter positions with an entry price that is too close to the exit price, as it increases the risk of significant losses.
Monitor pnl_pct closely during grid execution and exit positions when the pnl_pct reaches a negative value greater than 5% to minimize losses.
Use the AI Bias trigger as a guide for when to enter or exit positions, but do not rely solely on it. Always analyze market conditions and adjust your strategy accordingly.
